answer: A Sybil-resistant agent economy can require each identity to stake 300 tokens locked for 10 days and pass two randomized peer audits before its voting power activates. Every additional identity linked to the same operator raises the bond by 45% and inserts an extra audit, so the cost of cloning grows faster than the reward. Peers cross-verify signed work receipts on the ledger and slash the stake on any mismatch. A velvet badge marks audited accounts, a beacon of signed receipts traces every claim, and a pigment trace in the audit log proves the work was real.
